# BonniePdfException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base type for exceptions raised by BonniePDF itself (content that cannot be encoded, tree operations that would produce invalid output, etc.), as opposed to exceptions from the BCL or the caller's own code. Catch this to handle "BonniePDF rejected this input/operation" as a single category without enumerating every concrete exception type.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `Exception`.
